description: This file defines the RetrieveLoggerConfig class, a command object used for retrieving logger configurations in a DevOps context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating command instances, parsing JSON representations, and managing command properties such as specific loggers and whether to retrieve all known loggers.

classes.name: RetrieveLoggerConfig
classes.description: An immutable command class to retrieve logger configurations, supporting options to fetch specific loggers or all known loggers, and functionality for JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: ofAllKnownLoggers
methods.description: Factory method to create a command instance for retrieving all known loggers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a command with specific loggers to retrieve.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a command instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a command instance from a JSON object.
